Protocol.capture: Current original-account contracts and queried1..6 minimum-volume grids. One fixed previous completed15-minute quote window selected before requests; first causal complete route after1s, deadline20s, sides<=2s. Metadata and past quote context are known only at capture, not at historical quote time.
Protocol.decision: No full study or trade admission from a favorable counterfactual. If every current-capacity row has raw carry<=0, reject carry-only premise under observed terms before costs. Otherwise price/basis risk, actual simultaneous finance, fee history, rate continuity and independent predictive evidence remain required.
Protocol.financing: Per single ORDINARY unmultiplied charge.1/3/5 charge scenarios are not calendar forecasts; no triple-day or future-rate persistence assumed. Positive credits rounded down, debits away from zero to observed account money quantum.
Protocol.premise: A current-term discrepancy in financing among three FX legs might supply net cashflow to a partially currency-matched portfolio. No positive spot return, basis convergence or risk-free hedge is assumed.
Protocol.sizing: Both orientations fixed (+baseUSD,-baseJPY,+USDJPY) and its opposite. Equal base units from both queried grids; floor/ceil queried USDJPY units around baseUSD notional. Retain lot residuals; no automatic neutrality claim. Sum sign-specific queried margins and full2commission+3spread roundtrip cost against one200EUR capital.
Protocol.swapUnits: Accept explicit PIPS type0, daily24-hour current schedule and normal-account effective flag only. units*swapPips*10^(-pipPosition)*quoteToEUR. Other/absent fields unknown.
